d: When Ryder and the pups are knighted by the Princess of Barkingburg, they're put to the test when a disgruntled ex-Knight gains control of a dragon and attacks the castle.

st: Jungle Pups: Pups Find a Hidden Jungle
d: Ryder and the pups visit a hidden jungle and must use their new animal vehicles to help Tracker rescue the animal inhabitants from the hot lava and save their home.

st: Pups Save the Bay; Pups Save a Goodway
d: Ryder and the PAW Patrol clean up an oil spill in the water near Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol must help Mayor Goodway get a statue from the bottom of the bay.

st: Pups and the Kitty-tastrophe; Pups Save a Train
d: Ryder and the PAW Patrol rescue a lost kitty from the bay; Ryder, Rubble and Rocky must help free Katie and Cali's train from a rockslide.

st: X Marks the Spot
d: The Guppies help a friendly pirate search for treasure using a map.

st: Gup, Gup and Away!
d: The Bubble Guppies fly an airplane through the sky.

st: Firefighter Gil to the Rescue!
d: Gil and his team of firefighters must rescue another firefighter who is stuck in a tree.

st: Race Around Umi City
d: Team Umizoomi and UmiCar join the race around Umi City to beat Dump Truck and win the grand prize, a bunch of balloons, for their friend Sam.

st: Umi Egg Hunt
d: The team chases after a special egg in an underground rabbit city.

st: Mission PAW: Quest for the Crown
d: Chase and the team get called to Barkingburg to keep an eye on the crown.

st: Pups Save a Super Pup; Pups Save Ryder's Robot
d: Rubble gets into trouble while pretending to be a super pup; the PAW Patrol must help Ryder find his robot pup.

st: Pups and the Beanstalk; Pups Save the Turbots
d: Ryder and the pups must keep Giant Alex busy so that he does not cause damage in Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol must rescue Cap'n Turbot's cousin.

st: The Crew Builds a Train Station; The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Sign
d: Rubble and Crew build the first train station in Builder Cove just in time to welcome Farmer Zoe's new cow, Mooreen; Popstar Sierra Sparkle is moving to Builder Cove, but when the pups plan a surprise greeting, Speed Meister makes a plan of his own.

st: The Crew Builds a Hotel; The Crew Builds a Hiking Trail
d: Builder Cove gets its first hotel when Farmer Zoe's brother Hadley comes to visit; after a hiking trail sign mix-up confuses everyone going to Mr. Ducky-Doo's birthday party, Rubble and Crew help them get back on track.

st: Pups Save the Land Pirates; Pups Save the Birdwatching Turbots
d: When pirates Alex, Julia, Julius and Chick-ARR-letta set sail into the desert and become lost, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the land pirates; Cap'n Turbot and Francois chirp for help when a bird-watching contest leaves them up in the air.

st: Pups Save the Mayor's Race; Pups Save an Outlaw's Loot
d: Mayor Humdinger plans to cheat in the annual Mayor's Race; Ryder and Mayor Goodway find a treasure map while sorting through the old cabin of Outlaw Wild Wilbur.

st: Pups Save the Parrot; Pups Save the Queen Bee
d: The PAW Patrol heads to the jungle to help their friend find his lost parrot; the PAW Patrol discovers a beehive in Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse.

st: Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Pupmobiles
d: When Sid Swashbuckle and his pirate pooch, Arrby, swipe the pups' prestigious award, Ryder and the pups set out to recover it.

st: Pups Save the Flying Food; Pups Save a Ferris Wheel
d: Mr. Porter's delivery drones go out of control and air-drop food everywhere; Mayor Humdinger steals Adventure Bay's Ferris wheel.

st: The New Pup
d: Ryder surprises the pups with a new mobile lookout so they can save the day outside of Adventure Bay; Jake gets lost in the South Pole.

st: Secret Agent Nonny!
d: Secret Agent Nonny is on a mission to deliver mysterious messages to all of his agent friends, which are actually invitations to his own surprise birthday party.

st: The Spring Chicken Is Coming
d: The Bubble Guppies must grow a flower for the Spring Chicken.

st: The Unidentified Flying Orchestra!
d: After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra.

st: The Lonely Rhino
d: The Guppies learn about the zoo while trying to find a friend for a lonely rhinoceros.

st: Have a Cow!
d: The Bubble Guppies learn about farm animals.

st: A Big Splash!
d: On the Shimmy-Shimmy Islands, everyone's preparing for Queen Zooli's dance party, but each time they practice, a huge wave splashes them.

st: Bubble Medics to the Rescue!
d: In Ancient Greece, paramedics Zooli and Gil get a call for help from Nonny, so they fly toward him in their chariot ambulance; on the way, they're pursued by a Cyclops.

st: The Super Ballet Bowl!
d: Molly and the Guppies want to learn how to tell a story through dance.

st: Batterball!
d: Molly and Gil see how bubble-cakes are made when they step into Chef Stef's kitchen; the Guppies get their turn when they take the field to play batterbal; it'll take teamwork to run the kitchen-station bases and bake a treat!

st: The Sizzling Scampinis!
d: The Bubble Brothers Circus is coming to town, and all the Guppies are getting into the act: Goby the clown, Gil the acrobat, and Oona the lion tamer.

st: Bubble Kitty!
d: When Molly and Gil find a lost kitten named Bubble Kitty, they help take the cat home to Meownt Rushmore.

st: Swinging in the Rainforest!
d: City-slicker umbrella sellers Molly and Gil set up shop in the Amazon rainforest.

st: The Summer Camp Games!
d: Molly, Gil and the Guppies celebrate summer with lots of outdoor fun; Gil uses his camping skills to rescue Bubble Puppy during the Summer Camp Games.

st: Fishketball!
d: The Guppies prepare for a game of fishketball by practicing bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team.

st: Movie Night; Art House Day; Wildflower Wood; Sunny Day Games; Magic Trick
d: Peppa is at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; Madame Gazelle and Mr. Bull take the children to the woods to learn all about flowers; Peppa and George play in the garden.

st: Best Friend; Camping; The Playground; The School Fete; Mummy Pig's Birthday
d: Peppa's friend comes over to play; Peppa and her family go camping; Peppa and George go to the playground; Peppa and her family go to the school fête; the family celebrates Mummy Pig's birthday.

st: Super Potato Movie; TV Land; Bird Spotting; The Petting Farm; Goldie the Fish
d: Peppa and her friends visit the cinema; Peppa finds out how TV is made; Peppa and George go birdwatching; Peppa and friends visit a petting farm; Peppa takes Goldie the fish to visit Dr. Hamster the vet.

st: Mr. Fox's Shop; Shadows; International Day; The Rainy Day Game; Mummy Rabbit's Bump
d: Peppa and George visit Mr. Fox's Shop; the children realize that they have shadows; Peppa and her friends dress up in clothes from different countries; Daddy Pig teaches the children a game to play inside; Mummy Pig announces that she is pregnant.

st: Pups Save Christmas
d: When Santa's Sleigh crashes and the reindeer run off, Ryder and the PAW Patrol have to help Santa finish delivering presents and save Christmas.

st: Pups Save a Hum-Kicker; Pups Save the One-Man Band
d: Mayor Humdinger turns up the power on his robotic soccer cleats, the "Hum-Kickers", and starts wrecking the town; Francois causes musical mayhem, as a one-man band, when he plans a special song for Wally's birthday.

st: The Crew Builds A Stadium Dome; The Crew Builds A Baggage Claim
d: When Speed Meister rains on the Builder Cove Sing-Off, Rubble and Crew saves the show by building a giant dome over the stadium; Rubble and crew build an elaborate baggage claim system at the airport when nobody can find their bags after flying home.

st: Pups Save a Woodland Walrus; Pups Save a DJ in a Jam
d: After stowing away on the Turbots' camping trip, Wally the walrus gets stuck in a mountain crevasse, and it's up to Everest and the PAW Patrol to rescue him; Mayor Humdinger challenges Rubble for the right to deejay a dance party.
Kai, Lola, Rammy and Bobbi are four heroic deer that protect the animals who live in Central Forest and the people living in Platinum City; the futuristic metropolis that surrounds the forest.

st: The Super Snowman Contest
d: It's a snow day in Axle City, and Blaze and AJ are competing in the Super Snowman Contest; a giant snowball rolls them away, but Blaze and AJ must brave the elements to make it back in time to win.

st: Pups Raise the PAW Patroller; Pups Save the Crows
d: When Daring Danny sinks the PAW Patroller, the pups must find a way to raise their rig; the pups team up with Alex's mini patrol to retrieve mysteriously missing items.

st: Pups Find a Genie; Pups Save a Tightrope Walker
d: Rubble finds an old, brass jack-in-the-box with a genie inside who grants him three wishes; Francois Turbot prepares to walk a tightrope between the top of the bridge and the lookout tower.

st: Golfalami / Mar-Sleepwalker
d: Three energetic Marsupilamis leave their jungle world for the city where mystery and excitement await as they bond with twins eager to protect their extraordinary friends.

st: Pups Save the Balloon Pups; Pups Save the Spider Spies
d: When giant balloons float away from a parade, it's up to the pups to save the pup balloons, the parade and Mayor Humdinger; the Turbot cousins try to spot a rare spider but get stuck in its web.

st: The Crew Builds an Underwater Shell Museum; The Crew Builds a Giant Shoe Store
d: Wheeler discovers a giant ancient shell deep in a cave, but when the pups try to dig it out, the cave almost collapses; the pups have to save Wheeler when ducks take him for a wild ride on Shopkeeper Shelley's giant shoe-shaped shoe store!

st: Pups Save the Squirrels; Pups Save a Roo
d: The PAW Patrol is on a roll when squirrels stash acorns in Alex's treehouse, causing it to fall onto Daring Danny's skateboard; a switcheroo situation develops when a joey is separated from its mother.

st: Danny's Pirate Bedroom; Undersea Party; Woodland Club; Guinea Pigs; Bird Spotting
d: Peppa helps with a makeover; it's Goldie's birthday; Peppa is shown woodcraft; Madame Gazelle shows her pet to the children; Peppa and George go birdwatching with Grandpa Pig.

st: Recycling; The Boat Pond; Traffic Jam; Bedtime; Sports Day
d: Peppa and George tidy up; Peppa's family goes to the pond; Granny and Grandpa Pig invite Peppa to lunch; Peppa and George still want to play at bedtime; sports day.

st: Jumping Stick; Racquet Games; Adventure Caravan; Caravan Friends; Bowling
d: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the post; Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson; Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; after Peppa and family visit a tourist spot, the caravan unhooks from the car.

st: Swimming Lesson; Water Park; Canoe Trip; The Holiday; Sea Treasure
d: Rabbit is the instructor for swimming lessons, everyone helps teach Mummy Rabbit how to swim; Peppa and friends are going to a water park; Peppa and her family are going for a canoe trip; Peppa and her family go on a trip to a holiday home.

st: Rocky Saves Himself; Pups and the Mystery of the Driverless Snowcat
d: Rocky must rescue himself after being stranded on an island full of trash by Mayor Humdinger; Daring Danny's new remote control accidentally takes control of Everest's SnoCat and all the vehicles in Adventure Bay.

st: Pups Save a Box Fort; Pups Save Travelin' Travis From Really Big Bill
d: The Pups must save Rocky and Humdinger from a runaway box fort; when Skye helps Traveling Travis search for Big Bill Island, the misguided explorer gets carried away by a really, really big bird.

st: Jungle Pups: Pups Save the Meerkat Pirates; Jungle Pups: Pups Save a Hum-Hippo
d: Arrby recruits a crew of meerkats to gather magical seeds; Mayor Humdinger wants a hippo as his new hench-animal, but needs a rescue when it gallops off with Humdinger on its back.
